|eyes = dark}}'''Enid''' was the head cook at the Wondering Woman in Ebou Dar. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Enid}}She was in the employment of [[Setalle Anan]], before Mistress Anan left.

==Appearence==
Enid is a round woman with olive skin and dark eyes.{{ref/book|7|23}}

==Activities==
Enid wielded a long-handled wooden spoon like a scepter and directed three other people at the cooking and baking. Her marriage knife bore a full dozen stones.

It is not known what happened to her after Setalle escapes with [[Mat Cauthon]].
